name: Lost Rigger Cove
summary: Tucked away along the eastern cliffs of Tanaris, Lost Rigger Cove serves as the primary base of operations for the Southsea Pirates in the region. Shielded by towering desert mountains on three sides, this hidden port boasts docks, fortified encampments, and an active shipyard constructing new pirate vessels.

sections.title: Pirates and Mountain Walls
sections.body: Naturally fortified by sheer rock walls on almost every side, Lost Rigger Cove provides the Southsea Freebooters an ideal maritime stronghold on Kalimdor's southeastern edge. Here, pirate cutthroats, dockworkers, and brigands haul salvage and assemble fresh hulls right under the noses of Gadgetzan's authorities. The cove allows the Southseas to project power across the Great Sea while raiding trade routes between Ratchet, Booty Bay, and coastal settlements.

sections.title: Rivals on the Doorstep
sections.body: The pirates do not hold their cove unchallenged. The goblins of Gadgetzan and nearby Steamwheedle Port resent the raiders on their doorstep and pay mercenaries to slaughter the Southseas, thin their ranks, and disrupt their operations.

aliases: who lives in lost rigger cove
faq.answer: The cove is held by the Southsea Pirates, an infamous maritime syndicate operating throughout Kalimdor and the South Seas. They use this natural harbor to repair their fleet and construct new warships.

faq.q: Who is fighting the pirates here?
faq.answer: The goblins of Gadgetzan and Steamwheedle Port, who resent the raiders on their doorstep, hire passing adventurers to strike at the pirate stronghold and thin the Southsea ranks.

faq.q: Where is Lost Rigger Cove located?
aliases: how to get to lost rigger cove
faq.answer: It lies along the eastern coast of Tanaris, southeast of Gadgetzan. It is accessed through a winding canyon path cut through the coastal mountain barrier.

faq.q: What are the pirates building in the cove?
faq.answer: The Southsea Pirates operate an active drydock and shipyard in the center of the cove, where carpenters and brigands are busy assembling the hull of a large ocean-going war vessel.

angles.text: The sprawling pirate camp is dense with pockets to pick, private lockboxes, and cutthroats who know every dirty trick of maritime swashbuckling.
For gnomish tinkerers, the pirates' drydock is a crude but telling display of salvaged machinery and stolen parts, and a standing threat to every merchant vessel on the southern seas.
